_note: The river crab's life (the animal life kit, docs/plans/animal-life-cycle.md, step 3: breeding on, 2026-11-19; all numbers my picks, fun first). Sizes are shares of its usual size (0.82 blocks across with its legs); males a little bigger, with big claws (their own model), females smaller with small claws and a broad flap. Two ready crabs court face to face for 10 seconds (courtship ticks count every other game tick); she carries 4 to 8 eggs under her flap for 2 days, then lets out tiny crabs (0.12 blocks) that ride on her back a few seconds and scatter, grown in 3 days. The world's own spawns stay grown. Breeds only while fewer than 12 crabs live within 48 blocks and the river bed group (shared with the snails) is under its cap.
